titleZh: 中国版权保护中心著作权自愿登记收费标准
titleEn: CPCC Voluntary Copyright Registration Fee Standards
sumZh: 公布2018年10月26日修订的著作权自愿登记收费标准，逐类列明文字、音乐、美术、摄影、视听、软件汇编等作品的登记费用。
sumEn: Publishes the voluntary copyright registration fee standards revised on 2018-10-26, itemizing fees for text, music, art, photography, audiovisual and software works.

titleZh: 版权登记全解析：从流程到要点，一文读懂
titleEn: A Complete Guide to Copyright Registration: Process and Key Points
sumZh: 从注册实名认证、填写申请表、准备材料、缴纳费用、审核到获取证书，详解版权登记的完整流程与各环节要点。
sumEn: Details the complete copyright registration process from registration and verification, form filling, materials, fees and review to certificate issuance.

titleZh: 【登记指南】作品著作权登记
titleEn: Registration Guide: Works Copyright Registration
sumZh: 转载中国版权保护中心作品著作权登记指南，介绍办理方式、步骤、25个工作日时限、申请所需文件、收费标准及登记证书法律效力等常见问题。
sumEn: Reprints the CPCC works registration guide covering procedures, the 25-working-day limit, required documents, fees and FAQs on certificate legal effect.

titleZh: 国家版权局作品登记全解析：从提交到发证的7个关键节点
titleEn: A Complete Guide to Works Registration: 7 Key Stages from Filing to Certification
sumZh: 以文字作品登记为例，将版权登记拆分为在线提交、形式审查、缴费、实质审查、公告、制证发证及加急通道七个阶段，说明各阶段时限与注意事项。
sumEn: Using text works as an example, breaks copyright registration into seven stages—filing, formal review, payment, substantive review, announcement, issuance and expedited channel—with timelines and notes.
